1.t: Whereof do they question one another?

3.t: Concerning which they are in disagreement.

4.t: Nay, but they will come to know!

5.t: Nay, again, but they will come to know!

6.t: Have We not made the earth an expanse,

8.t: And We have created you in pairs,

9.t: And have appointed your sleep for repose,

10.t: And have appointed the night as a cloak,

11.t: And have appointed the day for livelihood.

12.t: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),

13.t: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,

14.t: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,

15.t: Thereby to produce grain and plant,

17.t: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,

18.t: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,

19.t: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,

20.t: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.

23.t: They will abide therein for ages.

24.t: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink

25.t: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:

27.t: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;

28.t: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.

29.t: Everything have We recorded in a Book.

30.t: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.

31.t: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -

33.t: And voluptuous women of equal age;

35.t: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -

36.t: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -

37.t: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.

38.t: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.

39.t: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.

40.t: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
